validation: Flutter Analyze reported no issues; all 181 Flutter tests passed. All 28 Worker tests passed, including two forty-page heading fixtures with mock model responses, Unicode-safe splitting, original page numbers, topic merging, bounded replies, conservative failure handling and atomic weighted quotas. The actual workerd/D1 runtime test verifies the weighted SQL. Local/remote migrations and Wrangler dry-run passed. Live model quality remains untested.
remote: Cloudflare OAuth and D1 migrations are verified. The Worker at https://growza-api.growza-worker.workers.dev passed HTTPS health (ok=true, ready=true, ai=false). Migration 0003 added model-call budgeting without changing existing request IDs; remote quota/token row counts were retained. Disabled AI and CORS denial remained correct. No live inference or student-data upload occurred. Model-response parsing now supports Gemma 4's documented choices format.
delivery: The Android ARM64 APK (111.57 MiB) was installed with package-preserving update on Moto G75. SQLite integrity passed. All pre-existing study/account rows, focus IDs/spans, legacy JSON and the student's paused timer were retained; secure-storage files were unchanged across installation. An additional account observed during ordinary device use was preserved. The temporary verification package was removed and the original Growza app reopened. No application exceptions were observed. The batch revision changes only the server; no new APK is required.
mcp: The official Cloudflare MCP endpoint was registered and OAuth verified. Codex configuration was backed up; restart Codex to load the new server. GitHub-hosted skills were omitted to respect the owner's prohibition. The optional beta cf CLI was unnecessary because the project uses Wrangler.
phone: Native device checks used a guarded, separate package running the production timer/storage UI with synthetic data. Home/background, screen lock/unlock and process restart retained the running record ID and deadline; no premature record was added. Paused state survived restart unchanged. A one-tap Home resume restarted focus. Explicit ending saved 294.371 seconds, excluded a 26.671-second pause gap and retained one record after reopening; topics remained incomplete. Android HTTPS health returned ready=true and ai=false. Student study tables were unchanged. These functional checks are not a performance benchmark.
